items.summary: Coherent just handed in a strong Q1 2027 report and the stock dropped almost 13% to about US$169 by the close. On the surface that move looks brutal. Underneath it, the photonics specialist posted US$2.37b in sales and basic earnings per share of US$1.96, both well ahead of where the business sat a year ago.
